theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, romantic, and sensual admin dashboard for adult content creators. It utilizes deep reds, rose gold accents, soft pinks, and warm dark backgrounds. The vibe is expensive, cinematic, and moody with a focus on 'Soft UI Evolution'.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-foreground
hierarchy.small_accent: text-xs font-sans font-medium tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-accent

colors.description: The palette revolves around extremely dark burgundy/wine (#0A0406) backgrounds, deeply saturated but soft crimson reds for actions (#E11D48), and rose gold/pink accents. The tone is strictly warm. No harsh cold grays; all grays must have a red/pink tint.

layout_and_spacing.container: Use generous padding: p-6 to p-10 inside cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between widgets.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento-style grids with slight asymmetry where possible. Instead of a rigid 3-column equal grid, use a 4-column base with span-2 and span-1 variations to create visual tension.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for a softer, organic feel. Hard edges should be avoided. Borders should be 1px and very subtle (border-white/5 in dark mode).

glassmorphism.usage: Headers, floating navigation, modals, and sticky action bars.

cards.usage: Data widgets, subscriber lists, revenue charts.
cards.classes: bg-card border border-border/50 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

buttons_primary.usage: Main CTAs like 'Go Live', 'Save Plan', 'Verify Payment'.
buttons_primary.classes: bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-600 to-red-600 text-white rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(225,29,72,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(225,29,72,0.4)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-300 border-none

animations_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must shift visually. Cards should have a slight border color shift to a deep red, and a very subtle y-axis lift (-translate-y-1).
animations_and_interactions.transitions: Use 300ms duration for layout shifts and 200ms for color/opacity changes. Avoid snappy/abrupt animations. Sensual means smooth and deliberate.
animations_and_interactions.loading: Use slow pulsating opacities or soft sweeping gradient lines rather than fast spinning loaders.

icons.style: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a delicate, premium feel. Avoid chunky icons.

shadcn_overrides.Card: Override default borders to be softer. Use rounded-2xl.
shadcn_overrides.Button: Use rounded-xl, avoid default Vercel stark look.
shadcn_overrides.Input: Soft dark backgrounds (bg-muted/50), 1px subtle border, focus-visible:ring-primary/50, rounded-xl.
shadcn_overrides.Tabs: Use pill-shaped indicators rather than underline for a softer feel. bg-muted/50 for the tab list.

image_urls.description: Deep red velvet theater curtain, perfect for the login page background or an elegant hero section behind a glassmorphism card.
Sensual portrait of a woman with red hair, suitable for creator profile pictures or 'Top Creator' showcase widgets.
Alluring dark studio photo, excellent for showcasing 'blurred paid posts' or premium video call previews.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs, table rows) must include `data-testid` attributes using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="go-live-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace font imports in index.css with Playfair Display and Poppins.
2. Apply the custom colors defined in this JSON to the Tailwind base layer.
3. Build the sidebar/navigation using glassmorphism if it floats, or a very dark solid background if fixed.
4. Use generous border radiuses (rounded-2xl/3xl) to achieve the 'Soft UI' look.
5. When displaying stats or revenue, use serif fonts for the numbers (Playfair Display) to convey luxury and wealth.
6. Do not use generic blue or purple gradients. Stick to the red/rose/burgundy palette.
